versions.prompt: Create a production-quality ORIGINAL game asset sprite sheet: exactly FIVE separate jewel puzzle tiles in a single perfectly straight horizontal row, orthographic straight-on front view, equal size and aligned, ample transparent spacing between tiles. Transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow outside the tile, no text, no labels, no UI. Each tile is a thick polished gemstone BLOCK with a nearly square silhouette and small clipped corners (not a diamond silhouette), rich brilliantly saturated body, a broad optical central face, strong beautifully sculpted triangular and trapezoidal facets, irregular localized highlights, internally luminous colored glass, deep colored lower facets, subtly curved refractive cut surfaces, exquisite crisp polished craft. Premium hand-painted 3D mobile jewel arcade game art, warm elegant storybook art direction, carefully authored lighting upper left. NOT simple flat rounded buttons, NOT nested concentric line borders, NOT dull metallic tokens, NOT plastic gummy candy. Each center symbol is sculpted intaglio into the same colored jewel material, with a bright narrow lower inner rim and dark upper inner wall, no separate flat white sticker. Left to right exactly: (1) vivid ruby-red jewel with heart intaglio, (2) luminous emerald-green jewel with triangle intaglio, (3) brilliant sapphire-blue jewel with diamond intaglio, (4) intensely luminous golden-yellow citrine jewel with five-point star intaglio, (5) vivid amethyst-purple jewel with crescent intaglio. The central symbol occupies about 40% of tile width and is unmistakable at 40px thumbnail size. The wide facets occupy 15% tile width around the broad face. Each tile has consistent size and silhouette, each has individualized optical highlights and subtle inner colored caustics. The complete row should fill 90% image width, five equal square tiles with even gutters. Real finished game asset quality, visual polish from sophisticated material shading and sculpted relief, no noisy detail. Original assets, not copied from any existing game.

versions.prompt: Edit the FIRST image, the original five-tile transparent sprite atlas. The SECOND image is a material/art-direction reference only; do not copy its assets, symbols, layout, logo, or UI. Preserve the first image’s five original tiles and exact left-to-right identities: red heart, green triangle, blue diamond, yellow star, purple crescent. Preserve one straight horizontal row of five equal square clipped-corner blocks, aligned and evenly spaced, transparent surroundings. Revise the material so it looks like premium warm storybook arcade jewel art rather than dark crystal/casino jewels. Raise colored midtones dramatically: central faces and bevels should be luminous saturated ruby red, emerald green, royal blue, sunny yellow, and violet, without nearly-black facets or deep black glyph pits. Simplify the cuts into fewer, broader, sculpturally convincing facet planes. Remove small fractured polygon noise, smoky texture, glassy transparency, and aggressive star-shaped glare. Keep beautifully crafted strong localized edge highlights, with a polished warm-white upper-left catch confined to a short bevel section, not a giant white star. The face should appear softly luminous semi-opaque gemstone enamel, with smooth broad color transitions and original glyphs integrated as sculpted relief of the same pigment; narrow lighter lower edges and medium-dark colored inner shadows, NOT white decal glyphs. The second reference demonstrates the desired broad midtone-rich playful material clarity and dimensional bevel craft. This edit should retain the original first image’s identities and small clipped corners but approach that clarity, saturation, consistent lighting and hand-painted 3D art polish. At 40px each tile should immediately read as one jewel with one clear large symbol. No text, no logos, no added objects, no external shadow, keep transparent alpha.
